sections_age_up_ck.name: sections_age_up_ck
sections_age_up_ck.value: ("sections"."age_up_age" is null) = ("sections"."age_up_rank_id" is null) and ("sections"."age_up_age" is null or "sections"."age_up_age" between 4 and 25)

users_platoon_role_ck.name: users_platoon_role_ck
users_platoon_role_ck.value: "users"."platoon_role" IS NULL OR "users"."platoon_id" IS NOT NULL

users_account_type_org_ck.name: users_account_type_org_ck
users_account_type_org_ck.value:
("users"."account_type" = 'superadmin' AND "users"."section_id" IS NULL AND "users"."rank_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("users"."account_type" = 'member' AND "users"."section_id" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."rank_id" IS NOT NULL)

users_id_number_ck.name: users_id_number_ck
users_id_number_ck.value:
("users"."id_type" = 'none' AND "users"."id_number_enc" IS NULL AND "users"."id_number_hash" IS NULL)
    OR ("users"."id_type" <> 'none' AND "users"."id_number_enc" IS NOT NULL AND "users"."id_number_hash" IS NOT NULL)

users_status_reason_ck.name: users_status_reason_ck
users_status_reason_ck.value:
("users"."status" = 'active' AND "users"."inactive_reason_id" IS NULL)
    OR ("users"."status" = 'inactive' AND "users"."inactive_reason_id" IS NOT NULL)
